display_name: 源域信道上下文与恢复先验交叉对照
description: 同一源 IQ 上交叉原 DURA 与固定候选的上下文和先验，定位源重建误差变化。

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source IQ 2x2 intervention; context jointly includes base, action and variance, no target identity inference

checkpoint.initialization: Original DURA and fixed final epoch5 source simulator action-guided candidate
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Require candidate source summary and checkpoint complete with expected commit, objective, seed, weight, and F/TX/target exclusions
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Prespecified candidate final epoch5; no target score selection

expected_artifacts: result.json per-group source paired NMSE and improved counts

rows.method: Original or candidate context crossed with original or candidate prior, four arms
rows.purpose: Distinguish context, prior, and interaction contributions
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.

notes: Diagnostic arms are not released recovery versions or target-selected models.
Context includes coarse base, action and noise variance together.
Source pilot excluded from candidate fit; original DURA may have seen this source domain.
No TX, F, V, target or model updates.
